source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "extended urbanization" OR "extended urbanisation" OR "planetary urbanization" OR "planetary urbanisation"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"extended urbanization" OR "extended urbanisation" OR "planetary urbanization" OR "planetary urbanisation",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("extended urbanisation" OR "extended urbanization" OR "planetary urbanisation" OR "planetary urbanization")
